title: SMPCore+
description: ✨ All-in-one SMP core with TPA GUI, Homes, RTP, Teams, Economy, AFK Zones, Settings, Chat Protection & PlaceholderAPI support.
body:
# ✨ SMPCorePlus

  _The modern all-in-one SMP core plugin for Paper servers._

  **SMPCorePlus** combines essential survival features, teleportation, economy tools, communication systems, AFK protection, and player utilities into a single lightweight plugin.

  > ⚠️ SMPCorePlus is not affiliated with DonutSMP. It provides SMP-style functionality inspired by popular SMP servers.

  ---

  # 🚀 Features

  ## 🌍 Teleportation

  ### Commands
  - /tpa
  - /tpahere
  - /tpaccept
  - /tpdeny
  - /tpauto
  - /rtp

  ### Features
  - Safe Random Teleport
  - Teleport Cooldowns
  - Teleport Request System
  - Combat Teleport Protection

  ---

  ## 🏠 Homes, Warps & Spawn

  ### Commands
  - /home
  - /sethome
  - /homes
  - /delhome
  - /warp
  - /setwarp
  - /warps
  - /delwarp
  - /spawn
  - /setspawn
  - /back

  ### Features
  - Multiple Homes
  - Permission-Based Home Limits
  - Warp Management
  - Spawn System
  - Last Location Tracking

  ---

  ## 💰 Economy

  ### Commands
  - /bal
  - /baltop
  - /pay
  - /payhistory
  - /eco

  ### Features
  - Economy Support
  - Richest Player Leaderboards
  - Payment History
  - Balance Top GUI
  - Supports:
    - 1k
    - 1M
    - 1B
    - 1T

  Example:
    /pay Steve 10k
    /pay Alex 5M
    /pay Player 1B

  ---

  ## 💬 Communication

  ### Commands
  - /msg
  - /reply
  - /ignore
  - /socialspy

  ### Features
  - Private Messaging
  - Staff Chat
  - Global Chat
  - Mention System
  - Chat Cooldowns
  - Anti-Spam Protection
  - Chat Formatter

  ---

  ## 🕒 AFK System

  ### Commands
  - /afk

  ### Features
  - Automatic AFK Detection
  - Manual AFK Mode
  - AFK Shield Protection
  - AFK Rewards
  - Movement Detection
  - Configurable Rewards

  ---

  ## 🎮 Player Utilities

  ### Commands
  - /workbench
  - /enderchest
  - /trash
  - /heal
  - /feed
  - /fly
  - /hat

  ---

  ## 📢 Server Features

  - Join Messages
  - Leave Messages
  - Death Messages
  - First Join Rewards
  - Playtime Tracking
  - Auto Announcements

  ---

  ## ⚙️ Modular Feature System

  Enable or disable individual modules without removing the plugin.

  Examples:
  - RTP
  - Economy
  - AFK Rewards
  - Chat Features
  - Teleport Requests

  ---

  ## 🔗 Integrations

  - Vault
  - PlaceholderAPI
  - LuckPerms

  ---

  ## 📊 PlaceholderAPI Support

  - %smpcoreplus_balance%
  - %smpcoreplus_team%
  - %smpcoreplus_afk%
  - %smpcoreplus_homes_count%
  - %smpcoreplus_homes_limit%

  and many more.

  ---

  # 🎯 Perfect For

  - SMP Servers
  - Survival Servers
  - Lifesteal Servers
  - Community Servers
  - Public Networks

  ---

  # ⚡ Lightweight & Optimized

  Built to replace multiple utility plugins while maintaining excellent performance and low resource usage.

  ### Requirements
  - Paper 1.21+
  - Java 21+

  ### Optional
  - Vault
  - PlaceholderAPI
  - LuckPerms
